name: Unlimited Value 2.0
description: AT&T's lowest-priced unlimited plan. You get unlimited data, but only the first 5GB each month is premium, so speeds may slow when the network is busy after that. Hotspot is limited to 3GB.

deals.title: $5/line off when you bring your own phone
deals.details: A $5/mo bill credit per line for up to 36 months on each new line that uses your own phone. Our prices leave this out, so with it you pay $5/line less.

deals.title: Extra $5/line off with 4+ new lines
deals.details: An extra $5/mo off each new line for 12 months when you have 4 or more lines.
